core_obligations: Spread the connected components of the generic fibre to a neighbourhood, using the irreducible-component bound as input.
Show the spread pieces remain separated in every fibre over a nonempty open, giving the lower bound n.

proof_roadmap.step: Decompose the generic fibre into connected components.
Spread the pieces using the irreducible-component bound.
Show separation persists in nearby fibres.

difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism over an irreducible base, if the generic fibre has n connected components then every fibre over a nonempty open has at least n connected components. The proof first bounds the irreducible component count using the corresponding lemma, then shows that the decomposition of the generic fibre into connected components spreads in such a way that the pieces remain separated in nearby fibres. Turning the irreducible-component bound into a connected-component bound is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7855-7881.
